title: gf2-kernels-hip permanent module scaffold
description:
Create the `gf2-kernels-hip/hip/permanent/` directory scaffold and Rust FFI surface that the per-prime HIP device kernels (T23-T25) will populate.

## Background

`gf2-kernels-hip` is opt-in via Cargo feature `hip` and excluded from the default workspace build per the project's HIP conventions. This issue lands the directory structure, the C++/HIP source layout convention, and the Rust FFI shim that the host-side dispatcher (T26) will call into.

No device kernels are implemented in this issue — only the build infrastructure (HIP bindgen, build.rs invocation of `hipcc`, conditional compilation under the `hip` feature). The downstream T23/T24/T25 lands the actual kernels.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/hip/permanent/` directory exists with placeholder `.hip` source files and the build-system entry points.
- [ ] [hard] `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/build.rs` is updated to compile the new module under feature `hip`; non-`hip` builds remain unaffected.
- [ ] [hard] Rust FFI surface `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/src/permanent/mod.rs` declares `extern \"C\"` shims (no implementation yet) for the per-prime entry points.
- [ ] [hard] On a non-ROCm host, `cargo build -p gf2-algebra --release --features simd,parallel,f5,f7,serde,test-support` (i.e. all `gf2-algebra` features minus `hip`) succeeds. **See Amendment 2026-05-15.**
- [ ] [hard] On a ROCm host, `cargo build -p gf2-kernels-hip --release --features hip` succeeds.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass.

## Amendment 2026-05-15 (user-approved — criterion 4 rewording)

The original criterion 4 read: `cargo build -p gf2-algebra --release --all-features (without hip) still succeeds`. The 2026-05-14 reviewer flagged that this is self-contradictory: `gf2-algebra` declares its own `hip` feature (`hip = [\"dep:gf2-kernels-hip\"]` at `crates/gf2-algebra/Cargo.toml:102`), so `--all-features` on `gf2-algebra` DOES enable `hip` and therefore reaches the HIP crate path dependency, which fails on non-ROCm hosts via `hipcc` / `amdhip64`.

The prior 2026-05-14 lead-direct amendment misread Cargo feature-unification semantics and is **withdrawn**.

**Replacement (user-approved via AskUserQuestion option A, 2026-05-15):** the criterion now reads `cargo build -p gf2-algebra --release --features simd,parallel,f5,f7,serde,test-support` (the full `gf2-algebra` feature surface minus `hip`). Equivalently: any non-`hip` feature combination on `gf2-algebra` builds clean on a non-ROCm host. The intent is unchanged: HIP/ROCm must not become a hard dependency for regular development; it stays opt-in via the `hip` feature.

This is a user-approved scope clarification (`references/escalation-policy.md` item 4) per the 2026-05-15 AskUserQuestion option A.
